senses.definition: A tool used for cutting hard substances, in particular wood or metal.

subsenses.definition: (usually) Such a tool with a toothed blade.
(sometimes) Such a tool with an abrasive coating instead of teeth.

senses.definition: (whist) The situation where two partners agree to trump a suit alternately, playing that suit to each other for the express purpose.

senses.definition: (intransitive) To be cut with a saw.
(transitive) To form or produce (something) by cutting with a saw.
examples: to saw boards or planks (i.e. to saw logs or timber into boards or planks)
